info.name: Techno Online Store - Tenant Orders API
info.description:
My orders endpoints for authenticated tenant customers.

Base URL: {{tenant_url}}/api

Set `tenant_url` to the tenant subdomain, e.g. `https://store1.example.com`
Set `auth_token` to the Sanctum token obtained from login/verify.

request.description: Get paginated list of authenticated user's orders, newest first.
